entities.text: Yashika @ Poonam And Another vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Deptt
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The applicants Yashika alias Poonam, aged about 22 years and her husband Birju alias Brijesh alias Mukesh, aged about 28 years, are present before this Court alongwith their Advocates Sri Kunwar Shankar Pratap Singh and Sri Ajay Kumar Shukla, who have identified the applicants.
The opp. party No. 2/complainant Smt. Kamlesh is also present in person before this Court alongwith her Advocates Ms. Shobha Rajpoot and Ms. Fatima Zehra, who have identified the complainant.
Sri Ashok Kumar Srivastava, learned A.G.A. is also present for the State/opp. party No. 1.

When this Court asked Smt. Kamlesh/complainant whether she want to pursue the criminal case against the applicant no. 2 Birju, she submitted that she is not interested and she wants that the matter may be closed by this Court exercising its extra-judicial power granted under Section 482,
Cr.P.C. She also submits that the daughter/applicant No. 1 and son-in-law/applicant No. 2 have already got married long back and due to their wedlock two children- one daughter, namely, Yashi,
aged about 3 years, and one son, Ishan, aged about one-and-a-half years, have born and they are living happily and satisfactorily.
When this Court asked Yashika alias Poonam/applicant No. 1 that whether she is happy with the husband Birju/applicant No. 2, she submits that she is happy and the husband is taking full care of her and her children.
Birju/applicant No. 2 is also present before this Court.
He also submits before this Court that he is taking full care of the wife/applicant No. 1 and the children and there is no any dispute of any type between them.

After considering the statements given by all the parties before this Court, especially by the complainant Smt. Kamlesh W/o late Munna Lal that she is not pursuing the matter any further and she has no objection if the proceedings of the case pending before the trial court is quashed by this Court and the present application is allowed.

Accordingly, being a peculiar case, proceedingand chargesheet dated 15-02-2015 proceeded in case crime No. 418/2014, U/s- 363, 366, 376 I.P.C. and 5L/6 POCSO Act, Police Station-Madion,
District-Lucknow, pending in the court of Additional District Judge Pocso (Main), Lucknow, State Vs Birju @ Birjesh @ Mukesh, and Compromise Deed dated 16-03-2024 settled between accused and complainant's wife, are hereby quashed.
The parties are at liberty to live together.
With the above observation, this petition is finally allowed.
(Shamim Ahmed, J.) Order Date :- 16.4.2024 A.Nigam  Yashika @ Poonam And Another vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Deptt.
